research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Formlabs is researching and developing methods and systems for film tensioning in additive fabrication devices, washing apparatus and methods for processing 3D printed parts, techniques for casting from additively fabricated molds, and improved additive fabrication devices utilizing LCD and LED light sources. Additional areas include process optimization, support structure generation, post-processing automation, and material formulations. These efforts span hardware, process, and material innovations in 3D printing.

overview_description.description:
Formlabs is developing an affordable high-resolution 3D printer to enable designers, engineers, and makers to realize their dreams in beautiful physical form easily. It manufactures 3D printing systems for various industries such as education, dentistry, health care, jewelry, and research.

Formlabs is the preferred professional 3D printer for engineers, designers, manufacturers, and decision-makers worldwide. Their product lineup includes the Form 3, Form 3B, and Form 3L, all powered by Low Force Stereolithography (LFS)™ technology, and the Form 2 SLA 3D printer. They also offer Form Wash and Form Cure post-processing solutions, the Fuse 1 SLS 3D printer, and the Form Cell manufacturing solution. Formlabs develops its high-performance materials, continuously pushing the boundaries of 3D printing, and provides  3D printing software.

about_short_description.short_description: Formlabs develops and manufactures 3D printers and software for the industrial sector.

product.name: Form 4 Series
product.description: SLA/MSLA resin 3D printers for producing detailed prototypes, functional parts, manufacturing aids, medical models, and dental products in professional and industrial workflows.

product.name: Fuse X1
product.description: An industrial selective laser sintering (SLS) 3D printer for producing polymer prototypes, manufacturing aids, and end-use parts without dedicated support structures.

product.name: Fuse 1+ 30W
product.description: An SLS 3D printer for producing strong nylon and other polymer parts, including functional prototypes, manufacturing aids, and low-volume end-use components.

product.name: SLA Resins
product.description: Photopolymer materials for Formlabs resin 3D printers, covering general-purpose, engineering, dental, medical, casting, elastomeric, and specialty applications.

product.name: SLS Powders
product.description: Polymer powder materials for Fuse Series SLS printers, used to produce durable prototypes, manufacturing aids, custom components, and end-use parts.

product.name: Form Wash and Form Cure
product.description: Post-processing equipment for washing uncured resin from printed parts and curing them to achieve more consistent final properties.
